title: Inter vs Parma: Stankovic to start ahead of Çalhanoğlu?
caption:
Inter host Parma at San Siro today and Çalhanoğlu is fit again — but Gazzetta dello Sport has Aleksandar Stankovic making his first start instead. Chivu confirmed on Friday, per inter.it, that both Djed Spence and Çalhanoğlu are available.
